title_en: Great Poems and Songs (20/20): Grandma Teaches Her Granddaughter Tang Poems
note_en: 无论……还是……，都…… means "whether... or..., (it's) all the same": 无论是想家、分别，还是看着时间一天天过去，这些感受……都没有变过 "whether it's homesickness, parting, or watching the days go by, these feelings have never changed." The options follow 无论 (often with 是), 还是 links the last one, and the main clause must contain 都. Don't leave out 都: English "whether" needs no partner word, but in Chinese the sentence sounds unfinished without it.
